description: This Kotlin source file defines the GatewayEventHandler class, which manages wake word synchronization with a gateway service, including scheduling updates, refreshing from the gateway, and handling wake word change events.

classes.name: GatewayEventHandler
classes.description: A class responsible for managing wake word synchronization between the device and the gateway, including scheduling, refreshing, and handling specific events.

methods.name: applyWakeWordsFromGateway
methods.description: Updates the local wake words list upon receiving new words from the gateway and temporarily suppresses wake words sync.

methods.name: scheduleWakeWordsSyncIfNeeded
methods.description: Schedules an update to send current wake words to the gateway after a delay, if connected and not suppressed.

methods.name: refreshWakeWordsFromGateway
methods.description: Fetches the current wake words from the gateway and applies them locally, handling potential errors.

methods.name: handleVoiceWakeChangedEvent
methods.description: Processes incoming JSON payloads indicating wake word changes, applying new wake words accordingly.
